groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: gripping, pinching, stirring.

chars.story: A hand moves round and round in the pot until it is all mixed.
chars.note: 攪 became 搅: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: Two hands cupped together, offering something up.
chars.note: Also 'to flatter': 吹捧.

chars.story: Thumb and finger close hard on a small thing.
Hands seize a trunk and heave until it shakes.
A hand slides along something long, stroking it.
chars.note: Slangy: 撸猫 'pet the cat', 撸铁 'pump iron'. 擼 became 撸.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: wet things.

chars.story: Water flung out and scattered in every direction.
chars.note: 灑 became 洒: the right side became 西.

chars.story: Water creeps in, a little at a time, until all is soaked.
A drop touches and clings: you get a little on you.
The tiny bits at the very edge of the water: bubbles.
Water standing in the eyes and running down: weeping.

groups.title: pools and banks 氵
groups.note: Still water and its edges.

chars.story: Water filling a deep, steep-sided hollow: a deep pool.
chars.note: 淵 became 渊: the inner part was simplified.

chars.story: Walking against the current, back toward the source.
Water settles and the grit sinks to the bottom.
chars.note: 澱 became 淀: the right side became 定.

chars.story: A small bit of land standing out of the water: a sandbar.
chars.note: Only seen in names (e.g. 长汀) and poetry.

chars.story: Water that gathers and stays among the reeds: a marsh.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: A tree on the left: wood, posts, tools.

chars.story: A young tree set into the ground: you plant it.
The wooden part of a tool that you take hold of.
A post of wood driven deep into the ground: a stake.
chars.note: Also counts cases or matters: 一桩事. 樁 became 桩.

chars.story: A long pole of wood carried over the shoulder.
chars.note: 槓 became 杠: the right side became 工.

chars.story: Wood boxed up for a dead official: a coffin.
A block of wood to rest the head on: a pillow.
Trees are counted one fruiting tree at a time.
chars.note: A counter for plants: 一棵树 'one tree'.

groups.title: fruits and palms
groups.note: Fruit trees and what they bear.

chars.story: A giant plant with long yellow fruit: the banana.
A plant bearing a glossy purple fruit: the eggplant.
chars.note: Also in 雪茄 (cigar, a loanword).

chars.story: A tree whose fruit keeps its seeds packed in: the pomegranate.
A tree with small oval fruit pressed for oil: the olive.
chars.note: 欖 became 榄: the right side became 览.

chars.story: The fibre of a palm tree is dark and brown.
chars.note: Also 'palm' (the tree).

groups.title: plants 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants of all kinds.

chars.story: A flower with petals packed in a tight bunch.
A prickly bush once used to flog wrongdoers.
chars.note: 荊 became 荆.

chars.story: Grass with blades as sharp as spears: thatching reeds.
chars.note: 名列前茅 means 'at the very front'.

groups.title: Buddhist words
groups.note: Characters borrowed to write Buddhist terms.

chars.story: A plant name borrowed to write a Buddhist saint.
chars.note: Meaning-less alone: only in 菩萨 and 菩提.

chars.story: A person alone at an altar, quiet and still: Zen.
chars.note: 禪 became 禅.

chars.story: A person written beside "add" to spell out a foreign word: used in Sanskrit terms.
chars.note: A transliteration character: 瑜伽 yoga, 伽利略 Galileo.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth on the left: breath and voice.

chars.story: A mouth gasping hard for air at the end of a run.
A mouth hailing someone across the water: hi!
chars.note: A loanword 'hi'; 嗨皮 is 'happy'.

chars.story: A mouth making low, muffled, crying noises.
chars.note: 嗚 became 呜. An interjection.

groups.title: eye 目
groups.note: An eye on the left: seeing.

chars.story: The eye catches what is right in front of it.
The eye struggling to get open: open wide.
chars.note: 睜 became 睁.

groups.title: animals
groups.note: Whales, apes and tiny crawlers.

chars.story: A fish as big as a capital city: the whale.
chars.note: 鯨 became 鲸: 魚 became 鱼.

chars.story: A beast with bright round eyes like stars: an ape.
A tiny insect marching in a line: an ant.
chars.note: 蟻 became 蚁: 義 became 义.

chars.story: The first half of the word for the fluttering insect.
chars.note: Never alone: only in 蝴蝶. See 蝶.

groups.title: wings and birds
groups.note: Feathers and the great bird.

chars.story: A bird so huge its wings fill the whole sky: the roc.
chars.note: The mythical bird of Zhuangzi; seen in names. 鵬 became 鹏.

chars.story: The feathered part that holds a bird up.
A feather standing up at the tip: it sticks up.
chars.note: 翹 became 翘: 堯 became 尧.

groups.title: the body
groups.note: Parts of the body, and its failure.

chars.story: The fleshy part you sit on.
A line of bone running down the back of the flesh.
A sickness that makes the limbs hard to move.
chars.note: 癱 became 瘫.

groups.title: stone 石
groups.note: A stone on the left: minerals and hard things.

chars.story: A stone that melts and flows when it burns: sulfur.
A flat, thin dish like a stone plate.

chars.parts: 王 jade + 白 white + 石 stone
chars.story: Jade and pale stone together: the blue-green of a gem.
A stone set on the side of the scale to weigh by.
chars.note: The unit pound (a loanword), or a scale.

groups.title: metal and casting
groups.note: Working metal.

chars.story: Molten metal poured into a mould and left to set.
chars.note: 鑄 became 铸: 壽 became 寿.

chars.story: A name cut deep into metal.
chars.note: 銘 became 铭: 金 became 钅.

chars.story: Ice-like ore melting under heat into a flow of metal.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Thread on the left: binding and seizing.

chars.story: A silk cord thrown round a criminal to hold him.
chars.note: 緝 became 缉: 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: Silk cord wound round and round and tied off: tie tight.
chars.note: 縛 became 缚: 糸 became 纟.

groups.title: grain 禾
groups.note: Grain on the left: crops and what is young.

chars.parts: 禾 grain + 匕 + 页 head
chars.story: The sharp tip of the grain stalk: bright and ahead of the rest.
chars.note: 穎 became 颖.

chars.story: A young shoot and a chick: both still small and tender.
Grain counted and checked against the record.
chars.note: Mostly seen in 滑稽 'funny'.

groups.title: mound 阝
groups.note: A mound on the left: slopes and passages.

chars.story: A sloping bank of earth.
chars.note: A transliteration character, as in 佛陀 Buddha.

chars.story: A passage driven right through a mound of earth.

groups.title: names and places
groups.note: Mostly meet in surnames and short place names.

chars.story: A town on the middle Yangtze: the short name for Hubei.
chars.note: Short name for Hubei; also surname E.

chars.story: An insect behind a gate: the old name of Fujian.
chars.note: Short name for Fujian. 閩 became 闽: 門 became 门.

chars.story: A horse galloping over ice: the surname Feng.
chars.note: A surname. 馮 became 冯: 馬 became 马.

groups.title: mountain 山
groups.note: Peaks and rock.

chars.parts: 山 mountain + 厓 cliff edge
chars.story: The sheer edge of a mountain: a cliff.
chars.note: His Analects card for 厂 is 'cliff'; 崖 is the full word.

chars.story: A bird on a lofty peak: the surname Cui.
chars.note: A surname; 崔嵬 means 'lofty'.

groups.title: low and rough
groups.note: Crude, despicable and unruly.

chars.story: A rough hut in the hollow of a hill: crude and bare.
A remote village out in the sticks: rustic, so looked down on.
Feet that cannot keep still: short-tempered.
People who have lost their place: wanderers, now rogues.
chars.note: Only seen in 流氓, 'hooligan'.

groups.title: shapes
groups.note: Narrow, bulging and crooked.

chars.story: A hole you can barely squeeze through.
chars.note: The everyday word for 'narrow' in speech; 狭 is the written one (狭窄).

chars.parts: - a bump standing up in the middle
chars.story: The middle sticks up like a hill: convex.
Not straight: it leans to one side.

groups.title: time 日
groups.note: The sun on the left or top: days past and present.

chars.parts: 艹 stacked days + 日 sun
chars.story: Days piled up on top of the sun: the past.
The sun shining on it: plain for all to see.
A meeting in plain daylight, face to face.
chars.note: A formal word for meeting.

chars.parts: - a shell-hoe shape for marking the seasons
chars.story: The old farming tool, tied to a time of day: the dragon hour.
chars.note: In 诞辰 (a respected person's birthday) and 星辰 (stars).

groups.title: virtue and feeling
groups.note: Qualities of heart and mind.

chars.story: Words that do not claim two credits at once: modest.
chars.note: 謙 became 谦: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: A heart set firm on a thing: earnest, sincere.
chars.note: 懇 became 恳.

chars.story: A bow before one in authority: venerate.
chars.note: 欽 became 钦: 金 became 钅.

chars.story: Shells consulted and the answer kept faithfully: loyal.
chars.note: 貞 became 贞: 貝 became 贝.

chars.story: A bow drawn out to its full span: grand.
chars.note: Mostly in 弘扬 'promote'.

chars.story: A heart that grieves for the one who is gone.

groups.title: fire 火
groups.note: Fire and flame.

chars.story: Fire leaping up and bright: a flame.
An offering set over a fire: cooking.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: A woman on the left.

chars.story: A woman of the court: a concubine or singing girl.
chars.note: Also in Japanese names (姬 'hime', princess).

chars.story: The older woman of the house: an elder brother's wife.

groups.title: earth 土
groups.note: Soil and what stands on it.

chars.story: Earth slumps until the whole thing breaks down.

chars.parts: 野 open land + 土 earth
chars.story: A house standing on its own plot of open ground: a villa.
chars.note: Only in 别墅.

groups.title: officials and the law
groups.note: Rank, inquiry and mercy.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 示 altar + 寸 hand
chars.story: A man given authority: a military officer.
chars.note: A military rank.

chars.story: Effort spent finding out what a place is really like.
A tap that wipes away the red mark of guilt.

chars.parts: - a bent figure holding out a hand
chars.story: A bent figure with a hand held out: begging.

groups.title: things
groups.note: Four things you can see.

chars.story: Bamboo stretched overhead to keep off sun and rain.
A leather cord for driving animals on.
A melon splits into slices, each like a petal.
A path shared by all who live along it: an alley.

groups.title: hurry and until
groups.note: Time words.

chars.story: A bundle flying off in a rush: hurried.
chars.note: His reading card: 'hurried'.

chars.story: Walking on and on without stopping, right up to now.
chars.note: Literary 'until': 迄今 'up to now'.

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a whale?
The walls are covered with blood.
The life span of a butterfly is short.
The sky is full of stars.

sentences.zh: 我观察到一只黑猩猩剥了一根香蕉并吃了它。
sentences.en: I observe a chimpanzee peel a banana and eat it.
